THE DISTINCT COUNT OF id IN Examination [has ExaminationThrombosis: '2'] [has ExaminationANAPattern: 'S'] [has ExaminationACLIgM m] has Patient has PatientID id WHERE m > THE AVERAGE ExaminationACLIgM + THE AVERAGE ExaminationACLIgM * 0.2
